Check the checkpoint scope before staging, after staging and after commit; roll back uncommitted writes on cancellation or conflict.
Preserve legacy write-only behavior and explicitly test it; report both primary and cleanup errors if rollback also fails.

assertions: prior checkpoint remains readable while staging
query allocation pool returns to zero

remaining: Sort run files and window multi-run checkpoints are not yet committed/rolled back as a single transaction; final checkpoint rollback alone does not remove already committed run files.

Legacy adapters without stageWrite cannot provide transactional cleanup.
Tests use actual in-memory spill bytes with controlled scanner rows, not new cloud fixtures or remote conditional-write adapters.
